messages.author: f6af277d20dc8607
messages.subject: Area_Adjacent
parts:
Dear Nick,
I am trying to run the DEC and DEC+j with a constrained which in this case is the area-adjacent. For some reasons it runs and ends stops at species 2539 and tells me with the following error message.
Error in tipranges_to_tip_condlikes_of_data_on_each_state(tipranges, phy,  : 
  STOP ERROR in tipranges_to_tip_condlikes_of_data_on_each_state():

Your geography file has a tip range which is not allowed in your specified state space (states_list).
The tip is: 2359
The range is: 1_3_4

Try editing either the geography file, the areas_allowed or areas_adjacency matrices, or the states_list (non-stratified) / lists_of_states_lists_0based (stratified).

 I tried to manually modify the R-script and exclude the following non-adjacent areas () as follows;
nonadjacent=c("AC","AD","AE","AF","AG","AH","BE","BG","BH","CG","CH","DF","DG","DH","EH")
ranges_list<-ranges_list[ranges_list %in% nonadjacent ==F]
ranges_list

But that the results I get are same like to those of the unconstrained.

I am attaching the tree, geodata and area-adjacent files for you to help me run and fix the problem.

Thank
Marie Claire
